verdict.rationale: Otter documents scheduling its AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings, so calendar-driven auto-capture exists in some form. The evidence never names a Google or Outlook calendar connection and gives no per-meeting-type rules for which meetings are captured. Community reports describe the bot auto-joining meetings unexpectedly, which indicates auto-join exists but says nothing about granular rules. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented Google/Outlook calendar connection, per-meeting-type or rule-based auto-capture controls (e.g. internal vs external, organizer-only), and independent corroboration of those controls.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
A potential customer's Otter.ai agent auto-joined a Teams call.
